description: Defines the ModifyResourceResponse class, a final immutable Java class representing the response to a ModifyResource command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing response data related to policy modifications.

classes.name: ModifyResourceResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a ModifyResource command, encapsulating details such as policy ID, label, resource key, created resource, HTTP status, and headers. Provides methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and response data access.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a new response indicating resource creation, with overloads accepting policy ID as String or PolicyId, resource object, label, and headers.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a new response indicating resource modification, with overloads accepting policy ID as String or PolicyId, resource key, label, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to create a ModifyResourceResponse instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getResourceCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Resource, if any.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON, if resource is present.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated Ditto headers.
